data.gender_notes: Thijs is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Dutch name 'Theodosius'. The name is composed of 'Theos' (God) and 'Hodos' (path or way). Thijs is a name for a person who is devoted and ardent in his faith. The name Thijs carries the meaning “Ardent, zealous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thijs usually hope their child will grow to embody ardent, zealous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
